title: Insulated skillion roof in an old factory alteration (Lochiel, Southland)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code E3 with E3/AS1 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Alteration to a cheese factory built in the mid-1930s on a large rural site: original 200 mm concrete walls and roof framing retained; new insulated skillion roof formed over new purlins, underlay and corrugated steel.
Wind zone assumed medium (NZS 3604). Evidence considered: owners' building surveyor report, the authority's submission, and an independent building physicist report commissioned by the Ministry.
Relevant instruments include Building Act ss 19 and 49, Acceptable Solution E3/AS1 and industry guidance on skillion roofs (Appendix B).
Decision: consented design complied with E3 and the consent was correctly granted; the skillion roof as built did not comply with the consent or E3; authority incorrect to issue the CCC.

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
